mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 3.5%, or Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation, triggering Fed rate hikes that compress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.5%, or Rank IC between CPIAUCSL YoY change and 20-day returns > -0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) and restrictive monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) amplify recession risk through labor market weakness and capital scarcity, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or interaction term coefficient (UNRATE × FEDFUNDS) > 0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing demand (HOUST > 1500) combined with robust retail sales (RSAFS > 700000) signals sustained consumer spending growth, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 700000, or Rank IC between conjunction condition and 60-day returns < 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.5%) reflects tight labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >50% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC between UNRATE and 5-day returns < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings visibility and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC between INDPRO and 60-day returns > -0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) suppress economic activity and equity valuations through elevated borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns > -0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, increasing recession probability and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term coefficient (HOUST change × RSAFS change) > 0 over any 3-year rolling window.
